chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Khalid and Al-Husayn ibn Saeed altogether, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Yahya ibn Imran Al-Halbi, from Husayn ibn Abi al-A'la, from Habib ibn Bishr, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'I heard my father (peace be upon him) saying: No, by Allah! There is nothing on the face of the earth more beloved to me than Taqiyya (dissimulation/prudence). O Habib! Indeed, whoever has Taqiyya, Allah will elevate him. O Habib! Whoever does not have Taqiyya, Allah will place him down. O Habib! The people are merely in a truce (of hostilities); so if that (hostilities) had been there, this (Taqiyya) would be there.'

key_terms.التَّقِيَّة: Taqiyya (prudent dissimulation or concealment of faith)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Taqiyya in Shia theology according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the prominent chain of al-Kulayni, underscores Taqiyya not merely as a defensive tactic but as a spiritual elevation mechanism, reflecting the Imams' strategic navigation of political instability. The reference to 'hudna' (truce) highlights the transitional nature of the current era, where concealment preserves the community until the conditions for open manifestation are met. This aligns with the Shia jurisprudential view that Taqiyya is a means of maintaining religious integrity and social cohesion under duress.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Khalid and Al Husayn Bin Saeed altogether from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Bin Imran Al Halby, from Husayn Bin Abu Al A’ala, from Habeeb Bin Bishr who said,

‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘I heard myasws fatherasws saying: ‘No, by Allahazwj! There is nothing on the face of the earth more beloved to measws than the dissimulation (Taqiyya). O Habeeb! The one who had dissimulation for him, Allahazwj would Elevate him. O Habeeb! The one who does not happen to have dissimulation (Taqiyya) for him, Allahazwj would Place him down. O Habeeb! The people, rather, they are in a truce (cessation of hostilities). So if that (hostilities) had been there, this (dissimulation) would be there’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn Khalid and al-Husayn ibn Sa’id all from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Yahya ibn ‘Imran al-Halabi from Husayn ibn abu al-‘Ala’ from Habib ibn Bishr who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘I heard my father saying, “By Allah, there is nothing on the face of earth more beloved to me than observing al-Taqiyyah (cautious protective measures).” O Habib, whoever observes al- Taqiyyah Allah raises him up. O Habib, whoever does not observe al-Taqiyyah Allah brings him low. O Habib, people live in peace. When that (reappearing of al-Mahdi) happens this (al- Taqiyyah) no more will happen.’”
